keyLimits.en: No paid tier exists; the tool and its API are free to use.

capabilities.en: Reports on the user experience of a page on mobile and desktop, and suggests concrete improvements.
Combines real-world field data (Chrome User Experience Report) with lab data (Lighthouse simulation).
Scores pages against Core Web Vitals: Largest Contentful Paint, Cumulative Layout Shift, Interaction to Next Paint, plus FCP, Speed Index and Total Blocking Time.

limitations.en: Field (real-user) data is only available for pages that are publicly crawlable and indexable, and have enough CrUX traffic.
Testing locations are limited to a few regions (North America, Europe, Asia), which may not reflect performance for other audiences.

reason.en: General performance/observability dashboarding, broader than a single-page audit.

missingAlternatives.name: WebPageTest
missingAlternatives.reason: Main independent alternative for detailed web performance testing, not in the catalogue.
